text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the URA awards
ceremony, and I'm waiting for the

broadcast of my mentor's big moment.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock! You in here, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Got a minute? I wanted
to talk to you about the
Derby exhibit.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking about the stuff we'll show.
But, like... I wanna make
things easier to
understand.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Right now it's kinda just a spread of information. But what I really want is for people to be floored by what they see!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe you'd have a good idea.
Thinking up ideas isn't
really my thing,
hehe...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Something flooring, huh? How about you
go into detail on what you
feel most
passionately about?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Something flooring, huh? How about you
go into detail on what you
feel most
passionately about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What I feel most passionately about?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you talk about the Derby, you
always tell me what each
runner was
thinking and feeling, right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you talk about the Derby, you
always tell me what each
runner was
thinking and feeling, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it!
So I should show the stuff that
has all the juicy lore!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've already got some other items I put
together that might work! All
right, time to
make a sweet exhibit!

Winning Ticket wants to start organizing
the displays, but the
broadcast is about to
begin.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Before that, mind if I watch something on
TV? My mentor's receiving
a URA award.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Before that, mind if I watch something on
TV? My mentor's receiving
a URA award.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Oguri's trainer,
right? I'll watch too!
This should be good!

I turn the TV on, and in a few moments,
the ceremony I've been
anticipating
begins.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your URA award! In
your long years of training, is
there a race
that stands out above the rest?

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I feel strongly about all the runners
I've worked with. So each
race has a
special place in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This award commemorates all your
amazing achievements. How did
you feel
when you heard you'd be receiving it?

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was so happy.
I couldn't believe it... I
wondered how I could
deserve it.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Not every racer's dreams came true. I was
never able to lead one of
my own to
victory in the Derby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
I sure wanted it though, same as anyone
involved in racing. They say
a Derby win's
the greatest honor one can achieve.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? So he never won the Derby...

I didn't realize until now,
but of all the big
titles he attained, not one
was the Derby.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I always hear that it's the pinnacle of
racing, but not even a veteran
trainer like
him could win it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I always hear that it's the pinnacle of
racing, but not even a veteran
trainer like
him could win it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know, the Derby was the very first big
race of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ever since it began, lots of dramas have
been made about the
amazing racers
who've tried so hard to win it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And everyone's super-duper serious about
it! That's why it's a huge challenge for
even a veteran trainer and the most
skilled racers to
win.

The fact that even my old mentor couldn't
win it convinces me of
Winning Ticket's
point.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
You even participated in a Derby once
where your runner was the favorite to win,
but in the end,
she didn't manage to clinch victory,
right?

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember it well.
I trained her until
she was all but assured of
victory. Even so,
her rivals gave her the slip in the final
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
Some people said if only we'd done this or
that, we would've come out on top. But
she'd given it everything she had—I knew I
couldn't
let myself think like them.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
I told her not to regret a thing—just
remember that she put her whole heart
into it. Learn and push forward... That's
what I realized we needed to do in the
end.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They're talking about the first Derby I
ever
saw! I watched it right at
the track with my
mom!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You were at the Derby he's talking about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm sure of it! It was an absolutely amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though his racer was the favorite,
she fell behind. But she was so
focused on
winning that she never gave up, even until
the very end!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I finally understood how precious the
Derby is after seeing that.
That's why I fell
in love with it.

Winning Ticket is enthralled with the
Derby. It all stems from her
seeing it once
as a kid, and that was the very Derby my
mentor and his trainee fought so hard in.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
I ended up retiring before I could ever
win
it... Now a member of
Team Sirius carries
on the dream though.

text_block_list.name: Predecessor
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe that trainer can finally
grab
the title.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's about you, right? He said you
can win it!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

It feels like my old teacher can see me
from the other side of the TV. Like he's
saying,
"Here's the dream. You've got this,
kid."

It feels like my old teacher can see me
from the other side of the TV. Like he's
saying,
"Here's the dream. You've got this,
kid."

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
A dream yet unfulfilled... It dawns on me
that I've been given
something very
precious. My mentor really believes in
me...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
A dream yet unfulfilled... It dawns on me
that I've been given
something very
precious. My mentor really believes in
me...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wha?! So you're gonna go after it?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAH! Now that's a story! A master who passes on the dream he couldn't achieve to his pupil!

Like she says, the whole thing does feel
like a story.

Right when I'm asked to help with an
exhibit, I end up meeting
someone whose
dream is winning the Derby.

And right when Winning Ticket comes to
the trainers' office, we hear
my mentor talk
about it. It's all connected...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The announcer's pretty good at interviewing too! I'm blown away that I got to hear this Derby story!

Could this be fate?
It certainly feels like it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? By "it," you mean...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-wait... Go for the Derby? W-w-with
me?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you want to win the Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you want to win the Derby, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Darn right I do! I've gotta win it! That's
been my dream since I was
little!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well,
now I feel like I've got to win it too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well,
now I feel like I've got to win it too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
So if you're up for it, let's go for it
together.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
So if you're up for it, let's go for it
together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
For...
for real? You sure you wanna partner
up with me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaah... Uwaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOHOOOOO! I GOT SCOUTED! Let's
do it, Trainer! Let's win the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm gonna earn you the title of
"Derby trainer"!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right. And I'm going to help you earn
the title of "Derby
champion."

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right. And I'm going to help you earn
the title of "Derby
champion."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sweet! I'm super stoked to be working with
you! All riiight! Let's go for
the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm Winning Ticket. Pleasure to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wow, someone with some real pep joined
the gang.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've heard much about you, Ticket. Your
goal is to win the Derby,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A great many racers share that goal.
You'll
have plenty of rivals, but
we'll help you
pursue this dream together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I promise to get Team Sirius a
Derby victory!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's drive for the Derby is the real
deal. I'm counting on you all to
give her
your full support!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, right on! Let's move out, newbie!
The sun shines on us today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Here we come, DEEERBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
I'm right there with ya! To
the DEEERBYYY!

And so the curtains rise on the story of
Winning Ticket and her pursuit
of victory
at the Japanese Derby.
